Market Trend Analysis
NASDAQ recovered after a mid-week pullback and confirmed a new buy signal with strong breadth (moreadvancing vs. declining stocks, rise in net highs, and increased stocks above MA200). Russell 2000 andsmall-/mid-cap stocks showed relative strength and may continue to outperform large-cap indices. ARKK ETF isconsolidating, reflecting digestion after its recent move.
Commodities & Crypto
Oil remains volatile without a clean actionable setup. Gold and Silver are consolidating and need more time beforeattractive entries emerge. Platinum is also choppy and not favorable at the moment. Bitcoin and Ethereum sawrebounds but remain volatile; no clear swing setups are actionable yet.
